name: admin.analytics.messages.metadata
purpose: Retrieves metadata for a list of messages from a given channel.

channel.desc: Channel ID for channel containing the messages to query.

oldest_ts.desc: Oldest timestamp to include in the results.

latest_ts.desc: Most recent timestamp to include in the results. If not passed, defaults to current time.

cursor.desc: Paginate through collections of data by setting the cursor parameter to a next_cursor attribute returned by a previous request's response_metadata. Default value fetches the first "page" of the collection. See pagination for more detail.
